properties.name: FOCUS_SKILL_RADIUS
properties.description:
The 'Focus' skill allows a merc to pay special attention to an area in their view
While focus is active, they have an improved interrupt chance against all targets in that area,
but drastically lowered interrupt chance against all targets outside.
Only works if center of area is in view and a gun is aimed.
Focus can be activated by calling the skill menu in tactical with '$' and then selecting 'Various' and then 'Focus'.
The radius of the area depends on how close the merc is, the area increases with distance.
Base radius of focus area for range 20.

properties.name: SNITCH_OPINION_ABOUT_MERC_BONUS_MODIFIER
properties.description:
How much chance is decreased by relation between snitch and target (0.0 - 10.0)
Note: by default relations are rated from -25 (hated) to 25 (buddy)

properties.name: SNITCH_LEADERSHIP_BONUS_MODIFIER
properties.description: How much chance is increased, depending on snitch's leadership skill (0.0 - 10.0)

properties.name: SOCIABLE_MERC_BONUS
properties.description: Bonus to chance if merc is sociable (-100 - 100)

properties.name: LONER_MERC_BONUS
properties.description: Bonus to chance if merc is loner (-100 - 100)

properties.name: SAME_ASSIGNMENT_BONUS
properties.description: Bonus to chance if snitch and merc are on the same assignment (-100 - 100)

properties.name: MERC_OPINION_ABOUT_MERC_TRESHOLD
properties.description:
For reports "merc hates merc" final chance is proportional to dislike in range between treshold (0%) and -25(100%)
(-25 - 25)

properties.name: PASSIVE_REPUTATION_GAIN
properties.description: Reputation gain per day if snitch is happy (0 - 100)

properties.name: HEARING_RANGE_BONUS
properties.description: Hearing range bonus (0 - 100)

properties.name: PRISON_SNITCH_INTERROGATION_MULTIPLIER
properties.description: Undercover snitch interrogation effectivness multiplier (compared to normal interrogation) (0.0 - 10.0)

properties.name: PRISON_SNITCH_GUARD_STRENGTH_MULTIPLIER
properties.description: Undercover snitch guarding effectivness multiplier (compared to normal guards) (0.0 - 10.0)

properties.name: GROUP_TIME_SPENT_FOR_TRAVELLING_BY_FOOT_REDUCTION
properties.description: Strategic map travel speed increased by a percentage if a survivalist is present in group

properties.name: MAX_STACKABLE_LESS_TRAVEL_TIME_BONUSES
properties.description: Maximum of above travel time bonuses that can be stacked for one group (1 Survival = 1 bonus, 2 Survival = 2 bonuses etc.)

properties.name: ENERGY_SPENT_TRAVEL_REDUCTION
properties.description:
Percentage reduction of stamina burn when travelling
(This only applies for survivalist himself.)

properties.name: WEATHER_PENALTIES_REDUCTION
properties.description: Percentage of weather penalties reduced. Values from 0.0 to 1.0.

properties.name: CAMO_WORNOUT_SPEED_REDUCTION
properties.description: Camouflage wear out percentage speed reduction

properties.name: TRACKER_MAX_RANGE
properties.description:
Survivalists can look out for tracks of people. This can be activated in the [Ctrl] + [C] menu.
This is the maximum range at which one can spot tracks.

properties.name: TRACKER_ABILITY
properties.description: per level of the trait, we can spot tracks at up to TRACKER_ABILITY % of TRACKER_MAX_RANGE. Values from 0 to 50, default 30.

properties.name: DISEASE_RESISTANCE
properties.description:
reduce likelihood of getting diseases by x percent
values from 0% to 100%

properties.name: FOOD_CONSUMPTION
properties.description:
modifies how fast food is consumed, e.g. -50 means food consumption is lowered by 50%
values from -100% to 100%

properties.name: SNAKE_EVADE_BONUS
properties.description: bonus to evade snake attacks in water

properties.name: CAMO_EFFECTIVENESS_BONUS
properties.description: bonus to base camouflage effectiveness
